user.title: Beurer BF500
user.description: Choose the scale. Wake it up first (step on it).

user_slot.title: User on the scale
user_slot.description: Which of the four user slots, and the 4-digit PIN set for it in the Beurer app. Each time Home Assistant reads the scale, it shows PAIr and a 6-digit number: press SET on the scale once to confirm.

pin.title: PIN for user {user}
pin.description: The scale rejected the PIN, or you want to change it. Enter the 4-digit PIN of this user slot as set in the Beurer HealthManager Pro app.

abort.no_devices_found: No BF500 found. Wake the scale and try again.
abort.already_configured: This user is already set up.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Import a CSV export of the Beurer HealthManager Pro app as long-term statistics for one user (hourly values, only before the sensors were created).

file.name: File
file.description: Path of the CSV file, relative to the config directory.

user.name: User slot
user.description: User slot on the scale (1-4) the export belongs to.
